brian-chesky.name: Brian Chesky
brian-chesky.bio: Brian Chesky is the co-founder,  Head of Community, and  CEO of Airbnb, which he started with Joe Gebbia and Nathan Blecharczyk in 2008. Brian sets the company’s strategy to connect people to unique travel experiences, and drives Airbnb’s mission to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. Originally from New York, Brian graduated from the Rhode Island School of Design where he received a Bachelor of Fine Arts in Industrial Design.
brian-chesky.title: Founder/CEO

nathan-blecharczyk.name: Nathan Blecharczyk
nathan-blecharczyk.bio: Nathan Blecharczyk is the co-founder, Chief Strategy Officer, and Chairman of Airbnb China. Nathan plays a leading role in driving key strategic initiatives across the global business. Previously he oversaw the creation of Airbnb’s engineering, data science, and performance marketing teams. Nathan became an entrepreneur in his youth, running a business while he was in high school that sold to clients in more than 20 countries. He earned a degree in Computer Science from Harvard University.
nathan-blecharczyk.title: Founder/CTO

joe-gebbia.name: Joe Gebbia
joe-gebbia.bio: Joe Gebbia is the co-founder of Airbnb which began in his San Francisco living room and spread to nearly 7M listings in 191+ countries, changing how people trust each other. Joe now holds a strategic advisory position and serves on the Board of Directors at Airbnb. His latest venture, Samara, also cemented in economic empowerment, housing resources, and design, produces fully customized, factory-made homes designed to create rental income, house family, and form new types of housing communities.
joe-gebbia.title: Founder/CPO

caroline-cochran.name: Caroline Cochran
caroline-cochran.bio: Caroline Cochran is the Co-Founder and Chief Operating Officer of Oklo Inc., a company developing advanced fission cleantech for cleaner air and human development. She was one of the youngest recipients of the University of Oklahoma Regent's Alumni Award. Caroline received her S.M. in Nuclear Engineering from MIT, a B.A. in Economics and a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Oklahoma.
caroline-cochran.title: Founder

apoorva-mehta.name: Apoorva Mehta
apoorva-mehta.bio: Apoorva Mehta is an Indian-born American entrepreneur. He is the Founder and Chairman of the San Francisco-based on-demand online grocery shop 'Instacart.' Apoorva co-founded this venture along with Max Mullen and Brandon Leonardo in 2012.  An engineering graduate from the 'University of Waterloo,' Apoorva worked for companies such as 'Blackberry,' ‘Qualcomm,’ and 'Amazon,' before he became an entrepreneur.
apoorva-mehta.title: Founder/Chairman & Founding CEO

brandon-leonardo.name: Brandon Leonardo
brandon-leonardo.bio: Brandon is currently Grocery Hacker and a Co-Founder of Instacart, the same-day grocery delivery service. Brandon built the early versions of the Instacart app, and now leads the Engineering team that works on Growth. Prior to joining Instacart, Brandon held senior engineering roles at a number of other startups including AngelList, Webs and StartupBus. He holds a BS in Computer Science from SJSU and currently lives in Redwood City.
brandon-leonardo.title: Founder

max-mullen.name: Max Mullen
max-mullen.bio: Max is the Co-Founder of Instacart. He started the company with two co-founders in 2012. Previously, he's worked for several startups including Schematic, an award-winning interactive agency which was acquired by WPP. Max is originally from Los Angeles where he graduated from the University of Southern California, studying entrepreneurship and cinematic arts.
max-mullen.title: Founder

drew-houston.name: Drew Houston
drew-houston.bio: Drew co-founded Dropbox in 2007. He’s led our growth from a simple idea to a service used by hundreds of millions of people around the world. Drew’s responsible for the direction and product strategy of our company.
drew-houston.title: Founder/CEO

chad-rigetti.name: Chad Rigetti
chad-rigetti.bio: I build quantum computers. Founder of Rigetti Computing (YC S14, NASDAQ: RGTI). ex-IBM. Yale Ph.D.
chad-rigetti.title: Founder/CEO

spenser-skates.name: Spenser Skates
spenser-skates.bio:
Spenser Skates is the CEO and cofounder of Amplitude. Amplitude started in 2012 to help organizations build better products through product analytics. Became a public company in 2021. Today, Amplitude serves more than 3,000 paying customers, guiding teams to clearer insights, faster action, and trusted data.

MIT 2010, Course 20 (Bioengineering). Won MIT's largest programming competition, Battlecode, 2 years in a row.
spenser-skates.title: Founder/CEO

alex-solomon.name: Alex Solomon
alex-solomon.bio: Co-Founder, PagerDuty. Alex started PagerDuty in 2009 as founding CEO, leading the company through several stages of growth, including product-market fit, fundraising, and expansion of the product vision. He replaced himself in 2016 and stepped into the role of CTO (until 2020), and later, GM of Platform (until 2024). He has served on the PagerDuty board of directors since 2010.
alex-solomon.title: Founder/CTO

jared-rodman.name: Jared Rodman
jared-rodman.bio: Love startups and love Utah. Happy to help any way I can so don't hesitate to reach out.
jared-rodman.title: Founder/CCO

uri-lopatin.name: Uri Lopatin
uri-lopatin.bio: Co-founder and the Chief Medical Officer of Assembly Pharma (2012) and CMO/VP R&D for Assembly Biosciences (f\k\a Ventrus Bioscience), which reverse merged with Assembly Pharma in 2014. He helped ASMB raise > $300M to move 2 generations of novel HBV meds into Ph 1 and Ph 2 clinical studies. Uri has held roles at Schering Plough, Roche, and Gilead Science, and received medical training at UMDNJ, NYU and the NIH. Uri was a visiting partner at YC before he started Pardes to cure COVID-19
uri-lopatin.title: Founder/CEO

mikhail-kokorich.name: Mikhail Kokorich
mikhail-kokorich.bio: Physicist, self-taught engineer, involuntary entrepreneur. Lots of companies in the past, most of them failed. But some have succeeded. 2 times YC founder.
mikhail-kokorich.title: Founder

nicolas-dessaigne.name: Nicolas Dessaigne
nicolas-dessaigne.bio: Nicolas is currently a general partner at YC. He is also the co-founder of Algolia (YC W14), a growth stage Search API used by millions of developers. He led the company as CEO up to 350 people before hiring a successor in 2020. Originally from France, he currently lives in El Cerrito, CA with his wife and 3 kids. He has a PhD in Computer Science from the University of Nantes.
nicolas-dessaigne.title: Founder/Board Member

julien-lemoine.name: Julien Lemoine
julien-lemoine.bio: Julien is a search veteran who’s been working in the search landscape for over 10 years, with work experience in Thales and Exalead. He participated in the design of three different search engines prior to co-founding Algolia with Nicolas and is the author of the different algorithms responsible for Algolia's super fast performance. Julien is also passionate about imparting knowledge and spent some time teaching at his Alma Mater, EPITA. He holds an engineering degree from the same institution.
julien-lemoine.title: Founder/CTO

yahya-mokhtarzada.name: Yahya Mokhtarzada
yahya-mokhtarzada.bio: Founder of Truebill, Acquired by Rocket Companies for $1.3b
yahya-mokhtarzada.title: Founder/CEO

haroon-mokhtarzada.name: Haroon Mokhtarzada
haroon-mokhtarzada.bio: Serial Entrepreneur / Angel Investor. Founder/CEO Webs (Sold to Vistaprint for $117M). Founder/CEO of Truebill (Sold to Rocket Companies for $1.3B) Angel investments: Relativity Space, Boom, Instacart, Sweetgreen, Rappi, PlutoTV, more.
haroon-mokhtarzada.title: Founder

justin-kan.name: Justin Kan
justin-kan.bio: Justin Kan is the CEO and co-founder of Atrium, a technology company and corporate law firm providing fast, transparent, and price-predictable business and legal services to startups. As a founder of multiple companies and an investor in hundreds more, Justin involuntarily became a power user of corporate legal services. Prior to Atrium, Justin was Founder of Twitch, Exec and Justin.tv.
justin-kan.title: Founder

emmett-shear.name: Emmett Shear
emmett-shear.bio: Emmett Shear is founder and CEO of Twitch (www.twitch.tv), the world’s leading video platform and community for gamers. Emmett is also co-founder of Justin.tv and a part-time partner at venture capital firm Y Combinator, where he advises fledgling startups on product and strategy. Emmett graduated from Yale University in 2005, where he met two of his Justin.tv co-founders.
emmett-shear.title: Founder

kyle-vogt.name: Kyle Vogt
kyle-vogt.bio: Kyle started Cruise in 2013, eventually selling it to GM for $1 billion. He stayed on and led Cruise to a $30 billion valuation, over $7 billion in investment, and 250,000 fully driverless rides delivered. Kyle also co-founded Twitch (acquired by Amazon), Socialcam (acquired by Autodesk), and Justin.tv. Kyle studied computer science and electrical engineering at MIT.
kyle-vogt.title: Founder/CEO

ralph-gootee.name: Ralph Gootee
ralph-gootee.bio:
My name is Ralph.  
- I'm a second time founder, my first company exited to ADSK for $900m Net.
- My background is abstract mathematics
- I have 3 young children
- My free time is spent reading and drawing
ralph-gootee.title: Founder/CTO

ryan-sutton-gee.name: Ryan Sutton-Gee
ryan-sutton-gee.bio:
Co-Founder of PlanGrid (YC W12) with Tracy Young, Ralph Gootee, Antoine Hersen, and Kenneth Stone.

PlanGrid was acquired by Autodesk in November 2018.

Currently an angel to seed stage startups mostly focused on B2B SaaS and/or the AEC vertical.

Investments:
Upcodes (S17)
Hightouch (S19)
Postscript (W19)
Hatch (W19)
Atmos (S20)
Toolbox (S20)
1Build (W20)
CostCertified (S21)
Concord Materials (S21)
PermitFlow (W22)
Pirros (W23)
HyperFrame
Built Robotics
ryan-sutton-gee.title: Founder

urska-srsen.name: Urska Srsen
urska-srsen.bio:
Urska Srsen is the co­founder and CCO of Bellabeat Inc. Urska is the detail­ obsessed execution force behind Bellabeat’s brand and products.
In 2016 Urska was chosen by Forbes as the ambassador of the Technology field for their first European 30 under 30 list. She was nominated as best female entrepreneur in Croatia in 2016 by Veuve Clicquot and has also received the Jabolko Navdiha (Apple of Inspiration) award from the President of the Republic of Slovenia.
urska-srsen.title: Founder/CCO

daniel-kan.name: Daniel Kan
daniel-kan.bio: Built Exec (W12), Cruise (W14), now Fifth Door (F25)
daniel-kan.title: Founder/COO

daniel-yanisse.name: Daniel Yanisse
daniel-yanisse.bio: Worked as a software engineer in a few startups before starting Checkr in 2014.
daniel-yanisse.title: Founder/CEO

nate-smith.name: Nate Smith
nate-smith.bio: Nate co-founded Lever, leading as both CEO and CTO. He is passionate about software’s potential for business transformation and user experience. Prior to Lever, Nate was a product manager on Google Analytics and the Google Search team. He led the first major redesign of Google’s image search UI, which launched in July 2010. Nate received a degree in electrical and computer engineering from Olin College, at which he was a member of the school’s second ever graduating class.
nate-smith.title: Founder/CEO/CTO

brian-noguchi.name: Brian Noguchi
brian-noguchi.bio: Founder of Smartcuts (W21) and cofounder of Lever (S12).
brian-noguchi.title: Founder

wei-deng.name: Wei Deng
wei-deng.bio: I'm a graduate of Yale and Yale Law School. Have done law, finance, product and operations, and am currently running a company that matches healthcare facilities with available nurses nearby.
wei-deng.title: Founder/CEO

dan-carroll.name: Dan Carroll
dan-carroll.bio: Co-founder / product @ Clever, figuring out what comes next
dan-carroll.title: Founder/CPO

rafael-garcia.name: Rafael Garcia
rafael-garcia.bio:
Co-founder and CTO at Kernel. We're making browser infra fast.

Previously co-founder and CTO at Clever (S12, exited for $500m).
rafael-garcia.title: Co-founder & CTO

victor-ho.name: Victor Ho
victor-ho.bio: Victor co-founded Fivestars following his work at McKinsey & Company, where he helped build out loyalty and customer engagement strategies for premiere Fortune 50 brands. He started his career as an investment banker at Goldman Sachs, and holds three degrees from the University of California, Berkeley, where he triple majored in Industrial Engineering, Rhetoric, and Business Administration. Victor has an insatiable love for sour candy, and can’t resist those tasty green apple things.
victor-ho.title: Founder/CEO

pete-koomen.name: Pete Koomen
pete-koomen.bio: General Partner at YC. Co-founded Optimizely (W10)
pete-koomen.title: Founder

bill-clerico.name: Bill Clerico
bill-clerico.bio: Founder & Managing Partner at Convective Capital - we invest in solutions to wildfire and climate change. Founder & former CEO at WePay.
bill-clerico.title: Founder/CEO

matt-feury.name: Matt Feury
matt-feury.bio: I spit rhymes in n log(n) time.
matt-feury.title: Founder/CTO

jean-baptiste-aviat.name: Jean-Baptiste Aviat
jean-baptiste-aviat.bio:
Co-founder at Droid Factory (YC P26).
Formerly co-founder & CTO at Sqreen (YC W18), acquired by Datadog.
jean-baptiste-aviat.title: Founder/CTO
